item_display_transforms.title: Item Display Transforms

binding.title: Binding
binding.description: Useful for items. A molang expression specifying the bone name of the parent skeletal hierarchy that this bone should use as the root transform. Without this field it will look for a bone in the parent entity with the same name as this bone. If both are missing, it will assume a local skeletal hierarchy (via the "parent" field). If that is also missing, it will attach to the owning entity's root transform.

ignore_inherited_scale.title: Ignore Inherited Scale
ignore_inherited_scale.description: Discard scale inherited from parent bone.

anyOf.title: <identifier>
anyOf.description: This is a list of locators associated with this bone. A locator is a point in model space that tracks a particular bone as the bone animates (by maintaining it's relationship to the bone through the animation).

poly_mesh.title: Poly Mesh
poly_mesh.description:
[Deprecated] A triangle or quad mesh object. Can be used in conjunction with cubes and texture geometry. This feature is deprecated, and using it in new content will result in content errors.

Properties:
• normalized_uvs (boolean)
• positions (string[])
• normals (string[])
• uvs (string[])
• polys (string[])

normalized_uvs.title: Normalized Uvs
normalized_uvs.description: If true, UVs are assumed to be [0-1]. If false, UVs are assumed to be [0-texture_width] and [0-texture_height] respectively.

use_pixel_depth.title: Use Pixel Depth
use_pixel_depth.description: If set to "true", the geometry will have a depth of one pixel (in entity space, not texture space). This causes geometries with a texture resolution different from 16x16 to appear stretched. If set to "false", the geometry will be built from perfectly cubic voxels, no matter the texture's aspect ratio. The default value is "true".

anyOf.title: Texture Meshes
anyOf.description: Adds a mesh to the bone's geometry by converting texels in a texture into voxels.
